uniforms.wl wt ws: state weights listening/thinking/speaking, eased k=1-exp(-4.5dt); idle = 1-wl-wt-ws

idle.look: scale x0.92, half-lidded (Mochi lid 0.38), sparse lattice (Bit), alpha x0.75

listening.look: scale x1.18, inward rings at 7/rim spacing speed 1.1, 28-tick VU ring at rim+0.075, eyes x1.3 fixed on user, lattice snaps upright and fills

thinking.look: scan band sweep 0.55 Hz, 6 orbit sparks, body cooled toward c2, eyes up-right + 3 thought dots, lattice spins with flow

speaking.beat: 0.75 pulse every 1.4-1.8 s (per phrase, never per syllable)
speaking.look: outward waves at 6/rim speed 1.6 scaled by mouth, centre waveform from bands, Mochi bounce + hearts, Bit column bounce

music.kick: exp(-7 phase) on even beats, bands 0..5
music.snare: exp(-9 phase) on odd beats, bands 8..15

tiers.flagship: 12 GB+, Gemma 4 E4B, braille pass 60 fps
tiers.mid: 8 GB, E2B, ramp pass 30 fps, rings off
tiers.budget: <=6 GB, launcher-only or E2B with warning, CPU text soul 10 fps
tiers.web: this site: 30 fps cap, 24 on phones; columns 56 / 80 / 112 by width
